question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 10.**
solution:
The correct answer is: everyone

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the proper meaning of these given words. 
 
 
• "Everyone" means all the people in a group or all the people in the world.
 
• "No one" means not a single person.
 
• "Either one" means means "this one or that one, but not both.
 
• "Someone" is used to refer to a single person when you do not know who they are or when it is not important who they are.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, 'everyone' should be used.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: "which welcome everybody year-round and are accessible."

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete passage: *Finland is a country of vast green forests, beautiful Baltic islands, windswept Arctic mountains and (1) countless __blue lakes. These pristine and picturesque landscapes (2) __provide __a habitat for many wild animals and birds including (3) *__magnificent __*bears, wolves, eagles, cranes and swans, as well as (4) __the __world’s rarest seals. Birdwatchers flock to Finland to find (5) *__species __*that are hard to spot anywhere else in Europe. Keen wildlife photographers __(6) also__ come here to enjoy excursions and facilities that enable (7) __them __to get spectacular shots of the amazing animals in their (8) __natural __settings. Some of the great places to preserve these (9) __creatures __include Finland’s forty national parks, which are open to **(10) __everyone __**all year round.*
